name: Eyelash extensions and false lash tutorials
what_it_is: Beauty videos about lashes: close-up strip false-lash application tutorials, lash-extension appointments and before/after results, lash-artist struggles, and product demos like pre-glued or double-ended liner pens used as lash glue. They span macro eye close-ups, GRWM vlogs and salon POV clips rather than one event.
